2608.06347.title: RP-OPSD: Reasoning-Pivot-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning Transfer
2608.06347.paper_summary: Multilingual reasoning transfer is crucial for extending reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) beyond high-resource languages. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) and its variants have emerged as a promising paradigm, providing dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts, yet their objectives do not explicitly prioritize reasoning signals most critical to cross-lingual transfer. We characterize that target-language reasoning comprises the generation of both surface text and reasoning pivots, which are decisions that advance or redirect the reasoning process and shape subsequent inference. This motivates concentrating privileged distillation around such pivots. We therefore propose RP-OPSD, Reasoning-Pivot-guided On-Policy Self-Distillation, using the distributional shift between matched teacher views with and without an English reference solution as an operational proxy to guide privileged distillation and reference anchoring. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks covering 17 languages and multiple difficulty levels show that our method outperforms strong multilingual reasoning baselines and OPSD variants. Further analysis reveals that RP-OPSD concentrates privileged distillation on reasoning-control and problem-condistioned state-update tokens, while downweighting it for tokens that mainly support surface realization. Our code is available at https://github.com/NJUNLP/RP-OPSD.
2608.06347.paper_summary_zh: 多語言推理轉移對於擴展大型語言模型（LLMs）在高資源語言之外的推理能力至關重要。政策內自我蒸餾（OPSD）及其變體已成為一種有前途的範式，為學生生成的展開提供密集的標記級監督，但其目標並未明確優先考慮對於跨語言轉移至關重要的推理信號。我們的特徵是目標語言推理包括生成表面文本和推理樞紐，這些是推進或重新引導推理過程並塑造後續推斷的決策。這促使我們集中在這些樞紐周圍的特權蒸餾。因此，我們提出了RP-OPSD，即推理樞紐引導的政策內自我蒸餾，利用匹配教師視圖之間的分佈變化（有和沒有英語參考解決方案）作為操作代理來指導特權蒸餾和參考錨定。在涵蓋17種語言和多個難度級別的數學推理基準上的實驗顯示，我們的方法超越了強大的多語言推理基準和OPSD變體。進一步分析顯示，RP-OPSD將特權蒸餾集中於推理控制和問題條件狀態更新標記上，同時降低了主要支持表面實現的標記的權重。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/NJUNLP/RP-OPSD 獲得。
